trap.label: sequência de ações
trap.wrong: I opened the door and was seeing a cat.
trap.right: I opened the door and saw a cat.
trap.why: Em português, 'abri a porta e vi um gato' vira continuous por analogia ao imperfeito; ações sequenciais ficam no Past Simple.

opts: He was falling while he ran.
He fell while he was running.

fix.wrong: I was getting up and ate.
While we ate, we were talking.
fix.right: While we were eating, we talked.

rewrite.prompt: Past continuous: “While I walk, I listen.”
rewrite.answer: While I was walking, I was listening.
